title: Open-source peer capability and FreeCAD integration-route refresh
mode: primary-source research with focused local implementation revalidation
scope: Compare modern DIMSTYLE resource reference handling across Autodesk DXF documentation and ezdxf
Reconcile LibreDWG and ACadSharp published routes with exact operation/version limits
Clarify FreeCAD's external DWG converter to DXF to selected-importer pipeline
Refine PAR-23/7J readiness without promoting support or expanding routine validation

sources.name: Autodesk DIMSTYLE DXF reference
sources.observation: Documents group 340 as referenced STYLE handle and groups 341-344 as referenced BLOCK handles; the page does not list DIMSTYLE codes 345-347.

sources.name: ezdxf DIMSTYLE internals
sources.observation: Describes name-to-handle resource mapping and R2007+ DIMSTYLE linetype handle codes 345-347 as undocumented.

sources.name: ezdxf Dimension API and source
sources.observation: Maps handle 0 to the default closed-filled arrow, resolves named arrows through BLOCK_RECORDs, and separates dimension entities from their anonymous graphical blocks.

sources.name: ezdxf linear dimension tutorial
sources.observation: Distinguishes arrow blocks from tick-size behavior and documents implementation-specific dimension rendering limitations.

sources.name: GNU LibreDWG 0.13.4 programs manual and overview
sources.observation: Documents full/minimal dwg2dxf routes, revision selection, binary DXF maturity caveats, and separate DWG read/write maturity.

sources.name: ACadSharp current README/version matrix
sources.observation: Publishes direction-specific version availability through AC1032 but not per-entity, graph, or native consumer semantics.

sources.name: FreeCAD current DWG importer
sources.observation: Routes DWG through an external converter and then DXF import; the reviewed LibreDWG path checks the expected output path exists after conversion, which does not prove semantic completeness.

sources.name: FreeCAD DWG preferences
sources.observation: Distinguishes converter choices and documents known LibreDWG fidelity limits.
